triggers: show the contents of a text file
open a config file in powershell

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Bounded root directory for the recursive search.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: PowerShell filename filter such as *.log or app.exe.

gotchas: Choose a narrow root; recursing an entire drive can be slow.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File path whose bytes should be hashed.

gotchas: A matching hash proves byte equality, not that a file is trustworthy.

summary: Read recent Service Control Manager records for services that terminated unexpectedly.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Number of recent hours to search.

parameters.name: max_events
